attributes.title: Founding GTM Engineer
attributes.description:
• 5+ years in outbound, SDR/BDR, growth or GTM roles at early-stage B2B SaaS (seed to Series B), with booked-meeting results you can show in numbers.
  • You’ve built outbound from zero at least once: lists, sending infrastructure, copy, sequences and reporting.

attributes.title: Desarrollador/a Full-Stack
attributes.description:
• Al menos 3 años de experiencia profesional con PHP y Laravel.
  • Experiencia desarrollando frontends con Vue.js.
  • Buen manejo de SQL y modelamiento de bases de datos relacionales (MySQL o SQL Server).
  • Experiencia construyendo y consumiendo APIs REST.

attributes.title: Senior Software Engineer
attributes.description:
• 5+ years building production web applications, with real ownership of systems on both frontend and backend.
  • Strong TypeScript, Next.js, Prisma and Postgres. You understand the server/client boundary, caching, and how schema and query design affect the product.

attributes.title: Especialista Integración Pleno
attributes.description:
• Experiencia en Java, mínimo 4 años, con conocimiento de Java 8 o superior.
  • Experiencia mínima 2 años en desarrollo y diseño de Microservicios.
  • Experiencia integrando Web Services SOAP.
  • Conocimientos de diseño de Apis / Restful.

attributes.title: AI Engineering Lead
attributes.description:
• 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years leading concurrent development workstreams or teams
  • C1 English level or higher
  • Expertise with AI Coding Assistants, AI Agent Frameworks, and Software Engineering

attributes.title: Senior Front-end Software Engineer
attributes.description:
• Strong professional Vue.js experience and proficiency with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience maintaining and modernizing mature, data-intensive single-page applications.
